name: Universal Class
definition: The **universal class** $\mathcal U_n=\{u_i:i\in[n]\}$ has domain $2^{[n]}$ and $u_i(A)=1$ exactly when $i\in A$. Equivalently, it is the dual class of the $n$-dimensional full cube.
comments: This is the minimal class witnessing dual VC dimension $n$.
origin_references: Used as the universal class in \cite{chornomaz2025spherical}.
